29 rows · mini-grid: rows A–F probability, columns 1–4 severity; outlined cell = the selection · Severity, probability and RAC are read from the most severe linked hazard's initial rating, never assigned here. Gap rows expose people to a hazard with no record yet.

g.text: Terms: 1A–4F = risk assessment code, severity 1–4 plus probability A–F (e.g. 1C) · AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · CONOPS = concept of operations · EXT-BYSTANDER = external element: bystanders · EXT-CREW = external element: ground crew and maintainers · EXT-OBSERVER = external

element: safety observer · EXT-PILOT = external element: pilot · F-nnn = system function in the item definition · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · I0–I3 = review independence level (I0 none, e.g. the author or an AI, to I3 independent organisation) · MOD-nnn = operating mode from the CONOPS (MOD-01 to MOD-10) ·

RAC = risk assessment code, severity category plus probability level (e.g. 1C) · SCN-nnn = CONOPS scenario (SCN-0nn nominal, SCN-1nn off-nominal) · SYS-nnn = system safety requirement record (requirements/SYS-nnn.yaml) · TBD = to be determined · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
